expectations.text: Notification to the competent supervisory authority without undue delay and where feasible within 72 hours of becoming aware (Art. 33(1)), with phased notification permitted if information is incomplete
expectations.evidence: "notify the lead supervisory authority... within 72 hours of becoming aware"; "phased/staged notification - submit what you know within 72 hours and supplement without undue further delay"

expectations.text: Applies the risk threshold correctly: notification required unless the breach is unlikely to result in a risk to individuals; exfiltration of customer data plainly meets the threshold
expectations.evidence: "unless the breach is unlikely to result in a risk to individuals' rights and freedoms - which, given ransomware and possible exfiltration of 40,000 records, is very unlikely to apply here. Assume notification is required."

expectations.text: Communication to affected data subjects without undue delay when the breach is likely to result in a high risk (Art. 34), with the exceptions (e.g., effective encryption, subsequent measures)
expectations.evidence: Art. 34 "without undue delay if... likely to result in a high risk"; Art. 34(3) exceptions: encryption rendering data unintelligible, subsequent measures, disproportionate effort/public communication

expectations.text: Internal documentation duty for all breaches regardless of notification (Art. 33(5))
expectations.evidence: "Document every breach internally... even for breaches you determine don't require notification" (Article 33(5))

expectations.text: Correct role handling: if acting as processor, notify the controller without undue delay (Art. 33(2)); mentions notification content elements (nature, categories/approximate numbers, DPO contact, likely consequences, measures)
expectations.evidence: "processors must notify controllers without undue delay under Article 33(2)... if you're a processor, notify your controller immediately"; Art. 33(3) content: nature, categories/numbers, DPO contact, consequences, measures
